info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/qwen-image-edit-2511
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/qwen-image-edit-2511 queue.

x-fal-metadata.about: Edit images using Qwen Image Edit 2511

output_format.description: The format of the generated image.
output_format.title: Output Format

num_images.description: The number of images to generate.
num_images.title: Num Images

num_inference_steps.description: The number of inference steps to perform.
num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps

seed.title: Seed
seed.description: The same seed and the same prompt given to the same version of the model will output the same image every time.

image_size.title: Image Size
image_size.description: The size of the generated image. If None, uses the input image dimensions.

prompt.description: The prompt to edit the image with.
prompt.title: Prompt

negative_prompt.description: The negative prompt to generate an image from.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

guidance_scale.description: The guidance scale to use for the image generation.
guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale

image_urls.description: The URLs of the images to edit.
image_urls.title: Image URLs

enable_safety_checker.description: If set to true, the safety checker will be enabled. Disabling it requires account authorization; unauthorized requests are always checked.
enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker

sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI.
sync_mode.title: Sync Mode

seed.title: Seed
seed.description:
Seed of the generated Image. It will be the same value of the one passed in the
            input or the randomly generated that was used in case none was passed.

has_nsfw_concepts.description: Whether the generated images contain NSFW concepts.
has_nsfw_concepts.title: Has Nsfw Concepts

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The prompt used for generating the image.

height.description: The height of the generated image.
height.title: Height

width.description: The width of the generated image.
width.title: Width

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
